caption: AI-generated work can look fine while hiding gaps. This carousel gives a practical five-step audit to verify accuracy. Save for future reviews. Which prompt will you use first? #AI #Productivity #DecisionMaking #Entrepreneur

slides.title: Polished AI can mislead
slides.body: Polished AI can mislead. This carousel promises five prompts to audit accuracy.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose gaps
slides.body: Diagnose gaps in the AI answer. List 5 missing facts with brief justification. Use [SOURCE] placeholders where needed.

slides.title: 2. Propose fixes
slides.body: Suggest concrete corrections to fix gaps. Provide revised text. Use [REV] for edits.

slides.title: 4. Cross-check
slides.body: Cross-check facts against two trusted sources; list any mismatches.

slides.title: 5. QA checklist
slides.body: Create a minimal QA rubric to prevent future errors.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Always run this five step audit before sharing AI work; accuracy supports better decisions.
